warnings: The two internal elevations of WC1, called from A-24. Between them every fixture in the room is located both in plan (A-24) and in height (here).

*** THE BATHROOM CEILING IS 2.70 M, NOT THE 2.50 M THE BUILDING SECTIONS GIVE FOR THE OTHER GROUND-FLOOR ROOMS. *** Measured from the same +0.40 datum. The bathroom ceiling is fixed close under the floor slab rather than at the general suspended line -- worth catching, since a take-off that applies 2.50 everywhere will under-measure the tiling.
Tiling runs FULL HEIGHT to the ceiling (wall mark 2 tagged three times per elevation with the hatch running the whole way up), not as a dado.
TWO MARKS APPEAR HERE THAT THE A-24 PLAN DOES NOT SHOW: M (mirror) and H1. A-26 defines H1 as the adjustable shower rail.
The fixture chain on the long wall (0.50 / 0.40 / 0.40 / 0.80 / 0.50 / 0.80 = 3.40) is the horizontal set-out; A-24's letter-direction chain is the same wall seen in plan. The two agree.
Window 5 from the A-23 schedule (1.75 x 0.60 awning) is the window drawn over the basin on รูปตัด B.

A-29 (PNG 31) later expands the marks used on these elevations. Two corrections land on this sheet's neighbours rather than on it: SP is a soap dish at 1.00 m, and the H on the A-24 plan is a towel rail, not a grab rail. M, the mirror shown here, is 0.60 x 1.00 with its top at 2.00 m and a 0.20 m gap above the basin.
